skills.name: develop
skills.purpose: Route repository explanation and change work through the lightest reliable path.

skills.name: finish
skills.purpose: Adaptively verify, review, simplify when useful, and report readiness.

skills.name: learn
skills.purpose: Resolve one blocking knowledge gap without polluting the primary workflow.

skills.name: shape-change
skills.purpose: Resolve material decisions and create accepted behavior and evidence contracts.

skills.name: plan-change
skills.purpose: Plan tracer-first slices only when sequencing, migration, rollout, or risk warrants it.

skills.name: implement-slice
skills.purpose: Implement one accepted slice or low-risk inline brief with deterministic evidence.

skills.name: diagnose-failure
skills.purpose: Find an evidence-backed root cause and fix only when requested.

skills.name: review-change
skills.purpose: Review a bounded diff against spec, standards, and engineering axes.

skills.name: simplify-change
skills.purpose: Simplify verified changed code without changing behavior.

skills.name: security-review
skills.purpose: Threat-model and review changed security boundaries with deterministic evidence.

skills.name: ui-quality
skills.purpose: Improve visible UI quality and common accessibility behavior.

skills.name: review-web-motion
skills.purpose: Review changed web motion using runtime, accessibility, and performance evidence.

skills.name: handoff-and-teach
skills.purpose: Transfer redacted work state or teach one blocking concept.
